column1: # compare_mask.tsv -- guest RAM words excluded from RAM comparisons between two runs (tools/native/native_boot.cpp
# B3NATIVE_MASKED_HASH: the whole RAM hashed with these words read as zero). Policy (2026-11-07): a mask list,
# not a change to what a run hashes (report masked vs unmasked counts).
# One row per writer, added only with its evidence, never in bulk:
#   addr     hex guest RAM word addresses, comma-separated (4-byte words)
#   class    why the values are not comparable: "retail reads uninitialised stack" (each lane from a stack slot the
#            writing function never wrote: tools/native/stack_slot_check.py / lane_trace.py, or a traced chain), "copy of a
#            masked lane" (a retail copy of another row's lane, shown by the poison value arriving verbatim), or "retail
#            computes from uninitialised stack" (a value computed from never-written stack words: the frame transplant --
#            B3NATIVE_FRAMEDUMP of a mixed native / retail run's frame at the function's entry, B3NATIVE_FRAMESET into an
#            all-retail run -- reproduces the mixed run's value, so only the frame's stale contents decide it; or B3NATIVE_STACKSET of the one
#            never-written slot changes the value and nothing else), or "retail carries its caller's stale register lane"
#            (mixed runs only: the lane reaches the store unwritten from the function's entry; its source changes again once the
#            caller is native and VU-binding-faithful -- re-check these rows when the native set grows)
#   evidence [C] the writer pcs, the stack slots and the frame (decomp assembly/asm)
#   readers  how no reader's result depends on the lanes: window, scene, poison value, and that RAM outside the masked
#            words matched over the whole window (B3NATIVE_POISON + B3NATIVE_MASKED_HASH). A lane
#            some result depends on is a real divergence source: it does not belong here. Defined values are bugs, not masks.
